They display features such as independence, reactivity, and social presence, complying with different paradigms like reactive or hybrid agents, backed up by decision models and machine learning. At the same time, they undoubtedly provide incredibly self-driven and personalized learning experiences, they also serve as a warning that some bias, dependence, and ethical issues may come to the surface.
